messages:
Sam K.: Heads up — kickoff with BlueHarbor POC tomorrow at 11am PT. Need to align success criteria, security asks, and pricing guardrails before the call.
Maya R.: thanks. quick list: target latency, sample prompts/evals, dataset access rules, and required SLAs?
Jordan (SE): Adding: whether they want Dedicated vs Hosted for the trial, and if they need KV caching turned on for prompt templates.
Priya - Sales: BlueHarbor is leaning Dedicated for data isolation but unclear on committed spend. Their legal asked for SOC2 + SSO.
Sam K.: ok. security team already flagged two things from the questionnaire: (1) inbound dataset encryption at rest + in transit; (2) no model training on customer data. SecBot will post the Q&A snippet.
SecBot: Security checklist excerpt: `encryption_at_rest: true`, `kms_integration: optional`, `data_retention: 30d default`. See https://redwood.example/internal/sec/blueharbor for full answers.
Oliver T.: For success metrics, suggest 3 buckets: quality (precision/acceptability), latency (p50/p95), and cost (tokens per completed request). Example thresholds: quality > 85% pass rate on eval set, p50 < 180ms, p95 < 450ms, cost < $40k / month for projected QPS.
Jordan (SE): Can we capture a small eval harness for them? I can prepare a 20-prompt set (intent classification + extractive QA) and run on hosted and a quantized dedicated variant.
Maya R.: yes please. also need to surface prompt engineering support. BlueHarbor will test L4 summarization + redaction of PHI — will need guidance on prompt templates and shardable evals.
Priya - Sales: timeline constraints: customer wants decision on next steps by EOD next Wed. That means we need results from initial eval by next Mon.
Sam K.: Action items: Jordan -> create eval harness + run baseline on hosted (due Mon EOW). Oliver -> draft target metrics and cost model for Dedicated vs Hosted (due Mon EOD). Maya -> compile security Qs and confirm SSO flow with customer (due Fri). Priya -> confirm stakeholders list and meeting invite (due today).
Jordan (SE): copying eval snippet here for internal reference:
```
# eval harness
prompts = ["Summarize clinical note:", "Redact PHI:"]
metrics = ["exact_match", "rouge_l", "toxicity_check"]
run_mode = "batch"
```
Will run 3 model variants: rdm-large, rdm-large-quant, rdm-medium.
Maya R.: I'll add SSO / SCIM details to the doc. BlueHarbor asked about on-prem private control plane; Sales said they'd consider for enterprise contract.
Oliver T.: One potential blocker: dataset transfer timeline. They have 2 TB of historical notes — need to confirm whether they can provide a sanitized sample set or we rely on synthetic data for initial eval. That impacts latency/cost estimates.
Priya - Sales: Stakeholders: Tom (CTO), Lina (Head of Data), Marcus (Security). I'll add them to the invite.
Sam K.: Great. If the eval shows quality delta < 3% between hosted and dedicated, recommend we propose hosted trial with a fallback Dedicated plan. If Dedicated materially improves latency/cost, we escalate to finance for reserved capacity pricing.
Jordan (SE): Noted. I'll include the config we used for continuous batching and KV caching in the report so they can reproduce.
SecBot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire before any data transfer.
Maya R.: one more question for the kickoff: do they require private network peering or will S3 presigned URLs suffice? I'll put both options on the agenda.
Priya - Sales: I'll send a short pre-read doc with the agenda + ask them to confirm sample data availability. Invite going out in 10m. :calendar:
thread_summary: POC kickoff prep for BlueHarbor: align success criteria (quality/latency/cost), clarify Dedicated vs Hosted, security Qs (SOC2/SSO/encryption), confirm eval harness and timeline, and identify blockers (data transfer). Owners and deadlines assigned.
